title: Peter Navarro reportedly initiated the Vulcan financing review
summary: ProPublica reported that the White House request to lend to Vulcan was made by Navarro.

sources.title: Company Tied to Donald Trump Jr. Got a Deal After White House Intervened

data.subject: starintel:person:peter-navarro
data.note: Attributed and contested process edge. The report says Navarro did not respond; White House, Department of War, 1789 Capital, Donald Trump Jr. and Vulcan denied preferential treatment or relevant involvement.

caveats: No primary White House-Pentagon communication was reviewed.
No reviewed source establishes that Navarro acted at Donald Trump Jr.'s request.
No reviewed source establishes that the conditional loan closed or disbursed.
counterevidence: The Department of War said outside affiliations and political connections play no role in funding decisions.
1789 Capital and Donald Trump Jr. denied involvement in obtaining the financing.
